title: An instrument bank: data/sound/banks/<bank>.json
description: An instrument bank of the sound archive (swan_sound_data.sdat), named by a BANK_* constant of data/constants/sound_banks.txt: the instruments that a sequence's program changes pick, like a voicegroup. tools/data/sound_data.py packs it, with the instruments' data in the order given here. Keys are numbers from 0 to 127 or names from Cm1 to G9, with s for sharp: C4 is 60.

wave_archives.description: Up to four wave archives (data/constants/sound_wave_archives.txt) that the instruments' wave_archive slots name

instruments.description: The instruments, in the order of their data

shares_data_with.description: Another bank whose instruments this one has, in place of instruments of its own

note_type.description: pcm plays a wave, psg a square wave and noise the noise channel

program.description: The program number (MIDI program) that picks the instrument, a list of them, or null for data no program uses

wave.description: The wave's number in its wave archive; for psg, the duty cycle from 0 (12.5%) to 6 (87.5%)

wave_archive.description: The slot of wave_archives that the wave is in

key.description: The key that plays the wave at its own pitch

last_key.description: The highest key of the region

first_key.description: A drum set's first key: drums gives a note for each key from it

regions.description: A key split's regions, each playing its note for the keys above the last region's last_key up to its own. A region after a higher one is never played
